methods.name: callback
methods.description: Applies the callback function to the field

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes the field value to be safely used in HTML templates without the risk of XSS attacks

methods.name: excerpt
methods.description: Creates an excerpt of the field value without html or any other formatting.

methods.name: html
methods.description: Converts the field content to valid HTML

methods.name: inline
methods.description: Strips all block-level HTML elements from the field value, it can be safely placed inside of other inline elements without the risk of breaking the HTML structure.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the field content is empty

methods.name: isFalse
methods.description: Checks if the field value is falsely

methods.name: isNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the field content is not empty

methods.name: isTrue
methods.description: Checks if the field value is truthy

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the field content with the given validator and parameters

methods.name: kirbytags
methods.description: Parses all KirbyTags without also parsing Markdown

methods.name: kirbytext
methods.description: Converts the field content from Markdown/Kirbytext to valid HTML

methods.name: kirbytextInline
methods.description: Converts the field content from inline Markdown/Kirbytext to valid HTML

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the field content

methods.name: lower
methods.description: Converts the field content to lowercase

methods.name: markdown
methods.description: Converts markdown to valid HTML

methods.name: nl2br
methods.description:
Converts all line breaks in the field content to `
` tags.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Provides a fallback if the field value is empty

methods.name: permalinksToUrls
methods.description: Parses the field value as DOM and replaces any permalinks in href/src attributes with the regular url This method is still experimental! You can use it to solve potential problems with permalinks already, but it might change in the future.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Uses the field value as Kirby query

methods.name: replace
methods.description: It parses any queries found in the field value.

methods.name: short
methods.description: Cuts the string after the given length and adds "…" if it is longer

methods.name: slug
methods.description: Converts the field content to a slug

methods.name: smartypants
methods.description: Applies SmartyPants to the field

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the field content into an array

methods.name: toBlocks
methods.description: Converts a yaml or json field to a Blocks object

methods.name: toBool
methods.description: Converts the field value into a proper boolean

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Parses the field value with the given method

methods.name: toDate
methods.description: Converts the field value to a timestamp or a formatted date

methods.name: toEntries
methods.description: Parse yaml entries data and convert it to a collection of field objects

methods.name: toEnum
methods.description: Converts the value to a case of the given enum $field->toEnum(MyEnum::class)

methods.name: toFile
methods.description: Returns a file object from a filename in the field

methods.name: toFiles
methods.description: Returns a file collection from a yaml list of filenames in the field

methods.name: toFloat
methods.description: Converts the field value into a proper float

methods.name: toInt
methods.description: Converts the field value into a proper integer

methods.name: toLayouts
methods.description: Parse layouts and turn them into Layout objects

methods.name: toLink
methods.description: Wraps a link tag around the field value. The field value is used as the link text

methods.name: toObject
methods.description: Parse yaml data and convert it to a content object

methods.name: toPage
methods.description: Returns a page object from a page id in the field

methods.name: toPages
methods.description: Returns a pages collection from a yaml list of page ids in the field

methods.name: toQrCode
methods.description: Turns the field value into an QR code object

methods.name: toStructure
methods.description: Converts a yaml field to a Structure object

methods.name: toTimestamp
methods.description: Converts the field value to a Unix timestamp

methods.name: toUrl
methods.description: Turns the field value into an absolute Url

methods.name: toUser
methods.description: Converts a user email address to a user object

methods.name: toUsers
methods.description: Returns a users collection from a yaml list of user email addresses in the field

methods.name: upper
methods.description: Converts the field content to uppercase

methods.name: widont
methods.description: Avoids typographical widows in strings by replacing the last space with ` `

methods.name: words
methods.description: Returns the number of words in the text

methods.name: xml
methods.description: Converts the field content to valid XML

methods.name: yaml
methods.description: Parses yaml in the field content and returns an array
